text: House File 2694 H-8186 Amend House File 2694 as follows: 1 1. Page 1, after line 10 by inserting: 2 < Sec. ___. Section 29C.6, subsection 1, Code 2026, is 3 amended to read as follows: 4 1. a. After finding a disaster exists or is threatened, 5 proclaim a state of disaster emergency. This proclamation 6 shall be in writing, indicate the area affected and the facts 7 upon which it is based, be signed by the governor, and be 8 filed with the secretary of state. If the state of disaster 9 emergency specifically constitutes a public health disaster 10 as defined in section 135.140 , the written proclamation shall 11 include a statement to that effect. A state of disaster 12 emergency shall continue for thirty days, unless sooner 13 terminated or extended in writing by the governor. The 14 general assembly may, by concurrent resolution, rescind this 15 proclamation. If the general assembly is not in session, 16 the legislative council may, by majority vote, rescind this 17 proclamation. Rescission shall be effective upon filing of the 18 concurrent resolution or resolution of the legislative council 19 with the secretary of state. A proclamation of disaster 20 emergency shall activate the disaster response and recovery 21 aspect of the state, local, and interjurisdictional disaster 22 emergency plans applicable to the political subdivision or area 23 in question and be authority for the deployment and use of any 24 forces to which the plan applies, and for use or distribution 25 of any supplies, equipment, and materials and facilities 26 assembled, stockpiled, or arranged to be made available. 27 b. A measure dictated in a state of disaster emergency shall 28 not do any of the following: 29 (1) Authorize a change to established laws, policies, or 30 regulations governing a local, county, or state election for 31 public office absent prior approval of the general assembly. 32 (2) Regulate conduct within a private residence. 33 (3) Require a vaccination. 34 c.
